card.name: Words just before neutralize or outweigh
card.fires_on: Words right before a verb meaning to cancel out, such as neutralize, counteract or outweigh. Strongest on protamine sulfate in heparin reversal text, and on 'sufficient to' before outweigh.

modes.label: Linking word before outweigh
